notes: thread field = shank diameter. Length conflicts: MAM 601261 kit titled 3/16 x 5/8 long for 3828549; NCRS 'C3 Rivet Identification' thread list gives 3828549 = 9/16 (with 3828548=7/16, 3828550=5/8); MAM 670636 lumps 3828546-3828550 as 7/16 long. MAM also lists 1/2 in head dia. NCRS page itself returned 403; quote is from search snippet. Pass 4: length recorded as a range. 5/8 per MAM 601261 and Corvette Central 182106 (Amazon listing '5/8" Long', GM 3828549); 9/16 per NCRS list and a CorvetteForum post (9/16 overall length, head top to end, rivet 'either 3828549 or 3831877'). MAM 670636 lumps 3828546-50 as 7/16, ignored as a lumped listing. Head: 1/2 in dia flat (Corvette Central, Dr. Rebuild). Diameter 3/16 from MAM only.
